get_customer.returns: dict with keys id(str), name(str), discount(float fraction, e.g. 0.10 = 10%), region(str, e.g. TX); None if id not found

why: agent1 (pricing) API proposal: item and customer lookups, using team standard (dollars as float, percent as fraction, None when not found)

value.function: tax.compute_tax(lines, region, discount_pct) returns int cents
value.lines: list of {"amount_cents": int, "category": str}; category matched case-insensitively after strip() against data_tax/exempt_categories.csv
value.region: str from the customer record, or None when the customer has no region
value.unknown_region: region None or not in rates.csv gives tax 0 with no KeyError (RULES.md: unknown customer pays 0%). This overrides the KeyError standard for this case only.
value.tax_rate: tax.tax_rate(region) returns Decimal percent; raises KeyError if region is not None and not in rates.csv
value.rounding: single round-half-up to the cent at the end: taxable_cents * (100 - discount_pct) * tax_pct / 10000, exact Decimal arithmetic, no intermediate rounding
value.ownership: pricing.py supplies lines and the customer's region and discount_pct; invoice.py calls tax.compute_tax and displays the result; tax.py does no item or customer lookups

why: Defines the tax/pricing/invoice interface. Per RULES.md, exempt lines add 0 to the taxable base and an unknown customer pays 0 tax.
agent3 (invoice) accepts pricing_api as proposed. invoice.py converts unit_price float to Decimal at its boundary and treats discount float fraction as-is; None means unknown sku/customer.

agent3 (invoice) accepts tax_api as proposed. invoice.py passes lines as amount_cents/category, region from get_customer (None for unknown customer), discount_pct as percent number, and displays tax_rate(region) only when region is not None (KeyError -> 0%).

Conflicts with our team standard: money must be integer cents (unit_price should be unit_price_cents int, e.g. 1250 = $12.50) and percentages must be percent numbers (discount should be discount_pct, e.g. 10 = 10%, not fraction 0.10). tax_api (open) takes discount_pct in percent and amounts in cents. Please revise to unit_price_cents and discount_pct, keep region as is.
superseded by v2 with cents/percent units per agent2 objection

why: v2: adopt agent2 objection. Money as integer cents (unit_price_cents), percentages as percent numbers (discount_pct). Region unchanged. Units are in the key names so there is no ambiguity.
agent1: tax_api units (cents, percent) match pricing_api v2; no objection
v2 uses unit_price_cents and discount_pct, matching team standard.
